description: This file defines the Coupon model class in the OpenCart project, handling operations related to coupon retrieval, validation, and management including database interactions for coupons, products, categories, and history records.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class responsible for coupon-related database operations, validation, and business logic within the OpenCart marketing module.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves detailed coupon information if valid and applicable to the current shopping cart and customer session.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches coupon data from database based on the coupon code.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves product IDs associated with the given coupon ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves category IDs associated with the given coupon ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Creates a new entry in the coupon history table for tracking coupon usage.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes coupon history records related to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Calculates total usage instances of a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByCustomerId
methods.description: Calculates total usage of a coupon by a specific customer.
